title: A giant shadow
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: the storm breaking before dawn, first pale morning light behind towering clouds, sea mist, emerald threat light.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): a second barnacled mechanical crab walker, visibly much larger than the first, with heavier armour plates, brighter green conduits, huge iron claws and hissing hydraulic pistons; Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important; the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks.
Camera: upward shot from the catwalk as the claw rises; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: A huge armoured claw rises above the catwalk and blots out the pale morning sky, casting the trio into shadow as they look up.
No dialogue.
Sound: dripping water, deep hydraulic hiss, wind dropping away.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (the second Leviathan, Penny, Tomkin, the masked hero), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
